## Overview

In this in-class activity, you will act as reviewers for **redacted AZA Conservation Grants Fund (CGF)** proposals.  
Your task is to **assess proposal quality, feasibility, and impact** using the same criteria AZA reviewers apply when determining which conservation projects to fund.

This simulation mirrors a real-world grant panel process, helping you:

- Evaluate conservation proposals critically and professionally.
- Recognize how reviewers weigh scientific merit, feasibility, and conservation significance.
- Practice consensus decision-making with peers.

## Instructions

1. You will be given **four redacted CGF proposals** to review.  
2. First, read your two assigned proposals individually and complete the **Detailed Reviewer Evaluation Form** below (15–20 minutes).
3. Next, skim the other two proposals so that you are prepared to discuss your teammates' assessment. (5-10 minutes).
4. Then, work as a team to compare scores and reach a **panel recommendation** (25–30 minutes).

## Panel Summary

After completing individual reviews, collaborate in your small group to summarize your consensus review.

### Resource Allocation

Your goal is to maximize your annual organizational budget toward advancing One Plan oriented conservation with maximum impact. You have a **budget of up to $35,000 to award**, and you may distribute this across as many awards as you choose. You may choose to reduce some awards below the requested budget (but do so carefully with project feasibility and output in mind). The table below provides some examples of the ways you might approach your budget allocation for this grant.

| Allocation Strategy | Projects Funded | Total Spent |
|----------------------|-----------------|--------------|
| Fund one proposal fully (e.g., \$23,000) and one partially (\$12,000) | 2 | \$35,000 |
| Fund three smaller projects at reduced levels (\$15,000 + \$10,000 + \$10,000) | 3 | \$35,000 |
| Fund only the strongest single proposal at full amount (\$23,000) and reserve balance for future cycle | 1 | \$23,000 |
| Distribute moderate partial awards across all proposals (e.g., \$10,000 each) | 4 | \$40,000 *(over budget—requires cuts elsewhere)* |
| Provide two full awards and one honorable mention (no funds) | 3 (2 funded) | \$34,000 |
